accepted_gaps.title: Candidate-to-phenotype causal-chain discontinuity
accepted_gaps.rationale: Sequence screens, chromatin analyses, and developmental phenotypes are insufficiently linked in the same causally interpretable design.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Require candidate, molecular mediator, cell-state endpoint, and a reciprocal perturbation test.

accepted_gaps.title: Separated testing of coding duplicates and regulatory variants
accepted_gaps.rationale: Gene duplications and enhancer/3D-contact variants may jointly regulate progenitor persistence but are rarely evaluated as alternatives or combinations.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Use a compact cross-class candidate panel and predeclare interaction tests.

accepted_gaps.title: Insufficient reciprocal genetic inference
accepted_gaps.rationale: Humanization alone or human loss alone cannot resolve dosage, editing, and species-background alternatives.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Pair chimpanzee humanization with human ancestral reversion and matched neutral controls.

accepted_gaps.title: Organoid fidelity and composition confounding
accepted_gaps.rationale: Species, line, protocol, maturation, regional identity, and stress programs can change cell-state proportions independently of the intended perturbation.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Gate comparisons on cell-state, quality, and reference-atlas concordance before model fitting.

accepted_gaps.title: Overbroad interpretation of cortical developmental phenotypes
accepted_gaps.rationale: A cortical organoid phenotype cannot establish cognition, language, or whole-organism human uniqueness.
accepted_gaps.downstream_requirement: Limit conclusions to predeclared cellular and molecular endpoints.

rejected_shortcuts: Rank all human-specific genes by differential expression and call the highest-ranked gene the cause.
Treat a HAR sequence difference as a mechanism without testing cellular context or target-gene linkage.
Use an organoid size difference as a stand-alone proxy for cortical expansion.
Infer organism-level cognition or species identity from an in-vitro progenitor phenotype.
